news_risk: No negative news, regulator action or enforcement item found. Searches for sanctions/regulatory coverage returned no relevant hits (search backend partially degraded — DuckDuckGo/searx unavailable, Bing returned irrelevant results, so absence of negative news is only partially evidenced). Contextual note, not adverse: the company is an IPO-track issuer (DRHP, shareholding pattern, corporate governance and material-contracts sections published on its site), which normally entails disclosure of litigation and regulatory matters in the DRHP. The company is a JV partner of ZKW Group GmbH (Austria), which became a subsidiary of LG Electronics in 2018 — a foreign-parent link worth noting for counterparty screening, but no designation of any group entity was found.
rf_supply: No evidence found of supplies to Russia or CIS. The company states it exports to '50+ countries' and is an OEM supplier to 40+ vehicle manufacturers (https://neolitezkw.com/), but no country-level breakdown, customs record or contract evidencing Russia/CIS deliveries was located. Indian Kanoon full-text search for 'Neolite ZKW' + 'Russia' returned zero results. Status: no trace of RF/CIS supply found; export geography unverified.
note: Risk-only review. Sanctions: no OFAC SDN / UN / EU / UK / BIS Entity List designation found for Neolite ZKW Lightings Pvt Ltd or its JV partner ZKW Group GmbH; OFAC Sanctions List Search tool was reachable but its query endpoint returned an application error, so the sanctions check rests on absence of any listing reference in open sources rather than a completed name-screen — recommend a formal re-screen. Court record is entirely the company AS PLAINTIFF/CREDITOR in commercial recovery suits (S.M. Enterprises, S.R.S. Auto Lines, Jaico Automobile) plus routine income-tax appellate matters (AY 2008-09, 2009-10) and a labour/MACT matter — no adverse judgment against the company found, no insolvency or winding-up petition against it. Per project rule 2, none of these are rejection grounds. Credit rating: page exists, specifics not public in retrieved text — null. RF/CIS supply: no trace found. Note the entity naming discrepancy: court records consistently use 'Neolite ZKW Lightings Pvt Ltd' (formerly Neolite Industries Pvt Ltd, renamed 08.04.2008), while the batch claims 'Limited' — legal-identity confirmation is outside this role's scope and is flagged for the legal-identity reviewer.
